correctness.rationale: All n>=4 exact difference follows from the known, independently reconstructed edge-indicator covariance identity and four-leaf local calculation; additional shared ancestor clades of sizes 4 to n-1 contribute exactly 2 q^j times the local mean difference. H_n is strictly increasing on (0,1), has signs -5 and 2n-1 at its endpoints, and H_(n+1)-H_n=2q^n. The limiting geometric series proves a unique algebraic limit. One-to-three-leaf shape uniqueness establishes minimality. Standard-library exact checker performed 61 checks including independent subset-moment expansions for n=4..9; this supplements rather than substitutes for the infinite proof.

The inspected literature does not contain the same sharp four-leaf topology-variance switch, mean-dominance contrast, all-n monotone threshold, or algebraic limiting threshold. residual_risks: General published variance formula can make specialized calculations straightforward; whether an unpublished or unindexed prior treatment proved this exact all-n crossover is unknown.

value.rationale: Variance-sensitive conservation assessments can disagree with expected-PD topology rankings even when one topology dominates in expectation at every extinction risk. The result gives a complete one-crossing formula and sharp first leaf count, not an arbitrary isolated numerical parameter choice, and its threshold is stable under grafting arbitrarily many taxa with a concrete algebraic limit.
